description: This file defines the DashboardScreen widget in a Flutter application. It displays a list of sites with status indicators, supports pull-to-refresh, and navigates to site details. The file manages fetch and health check logic for site data via the app state.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying a list of sites with status chips and refresh capability.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dashboard’s dynamic data, health status, and UI updates.

classes.name: _SiteTile
classes.description: Stateless widget representing individual site entries in the list, showing name, address, status chip, and navigation to detail.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget, performs health check and fetch operations asynchronously after creation.

methods.name: _statusColor
methods.description: Determines the color of status indicators based on the site status string.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard, including app bar, list view, and refresh logic.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Returns color for site status, similar to _statusColor, used for chips.
